items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I’ll have tears in my eyes if I listen to Joe Wilder or Warren Vache.

ctx.x: And all the wonderful people that I meet, musicians and non-musicians alike, they transcend all the baloney. And that’s good. I think it’s good. I’ll have tears in my eyes if I listen to Joe Wilder or Warren Vache.
